mapper.select: select r.*, m.mname from rating r join member m on r.mno = m.mno order by r.rno desc
select r.*, m.mname, m.memail, b.bname, b.bimg, b.bprice from rating r join member m on r.mno = m.mno left join book b on r.bno = b.bno where r.rno = #{rno}
mapper.insert: insert into rating(rno, rrate, rtitle, rcontent, rfiles, rdate, rhit, mno, bno, odno) values(RATING_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{rrate}, #{rtitle}, #{rcontent}, #{rfiles, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE, 0, #{mno}, #{bno}, #{odno})
